documentationLocation: In the app, click the upper right menu drop down and look for 'Supported Applications' in the tiles.
extractionNotes: App support data is in app only, but fairly clean in a table format making it easy to understand.

documentationLocation: Cellebrite portal Technical Data Sheet: SupportedApps HTML (DE release matrix).
extractionNotes: Parsed from DE SupportedApps HTML via capture-cellebrite-artifacts-list.py. Device platforms only (Android/iOS); Cloud and Warrant skipped. Native OS rows are expanded to Android/Apple {artifact} names. Supported versions is semicolon-joined; artifacts is the deduped union of artifact icons across versions.

documentationLocation: Local sibling repos: iLEAPP and ALEAPP scripts/artifacts/*.py (__artifacts_v2__).
extractionNotes: Merged from local iLEAPP (iOS) and ALEAPP (Android) via capture-leapp-artifacts-list-local.py. Catalog fields only (name, description, category, notes, author, paths, dates) plus Platform/sourceTool. Drops LEAPP UI config such as data_views. Files that build __artifacts_v2__ with helpers (e.g. ALEAPP fitbit.py) are skipped by static parse.
Live GET https://apps.mobiledit.com/api/applications plus per-id detail. One row per vendor application id. Keeps package, dataKinds, extractionTypes, store/website URLs, and iconUrl (URL only).
Fetched from data/artifacts_info.json via capture-artifast-artifacts-list.py. iOS and Android only. appNameKey is vendor application (product grouping), not artifact_name.

Parsed from the public FTK Suite Artifacts Guide PDF via capture-ftk-artifacts-list.py. Mobile Android/iOS Attribute names only (Associated Columns dropped). chapter/section come from PDF headings. Chat-table versions overlay matching attributes; unmatched chat products are source=chat-table stubs.
